html:
The Yukpa are a Cariban-speaking people of the Serranía del Perijá, the mountain range on the border of Colombia and Venezuela, west of Lake Maracaibo. They live on both sides of the border, in Cesar department in Colombia and Zulia state in Venezuela.

They farm maize, cassava and plantains on the mountain slopes and hunt in the forest. Spanish settlers and missionaries reached them from the 1600s, and later cattle ranchers took the foothills. In Venezuela the Yukpa have fought ranchers for their land for decades; their leader Sabino Romero was killed in 2013. Their language is part of the Cariban family.
